stage.name: Space 54
stage.type: Bonus stage (unlocked with 5 Gold Fingers); wiki stage id SPAZIE
stage.spawn_type: Standard: enemies appear from all four directions of the player
stage.modifiers_note: Wiki infobox gives player speed x1.25, greed +30%, destructible chance 10% (max 90%), max 16; starting_spawns and enemy_speed are not on the wiki (assumed 40 and 1). Hyper: player speed x1.9, greed x1.8, luck x1.1 (not needed).
stage.enemy_cap_rule: Periodic spawning stops while 300 or more enemies are alive; only bosses and map-event enemies can still spawn (Map event page).
stage.spawn_rule: Each minute's wave has a minimum enemy count and a spawn interval. If alive count < minimum, spawn until the quota is filled; otherwise spawn one of each enemy type in the wave per interval. Bosses are teleported back onto screen rather than despawned.
stage.map_event_chance_rule: Event chance is divided by player Luck (chanceWithLuck = eventChance / totalLuck); evaluated per repeat; no chance or 0 means guaranteed.

relics.position: appears north or south of the player at 18:00

layout.size_note: Not stated on the wiki; a platform exists to the north of the start. Distances unknown.
layout.obstacles: Unknown; a few platforms (wiki tip mentions one north of the start). Estimate: sparse.
layout.theme: Space/cosmic stage: dimensionally misaligned cosmos, disco and Phaser-engine references, moon and stars, aliens and space food.
special_mechanics: Stage items: Candelabrador, Empty Tome and the Phas3r weapon are placed on the map.
Merchants appear on the map; Brave Story relic appears at 18:00.
Ducks, rabbits and Gala Invaders arrive as Fixed Direction map events rather than chasing.
ECMASlime: Extra Large splits into 2 Large on death, Large into 2 Normal.

chest_rules.roll_order: 5-item chance first, then 3-item, then 1-item; each chance is multiplied by player Luck; compared to a random 0-100 per roll; fallback_level is the chest tier if all fail.
chest_rules.evo: If an evolution is available, evo-flagged chests can evolve a weapon (generally one per chest); the wiki table's evo flag meaning is inferred from the treasure template.
chest_rules.reward_flags_note: reward1/reward4/reward5 flags exist in the treasure template; their exact meaning is not documented on the pages read (unknown).
chest_rules.wiki_table_parse_note: First-minute-of-stage values: '1:00 ... evo=1' etc. copied verbatim; a blank evo means not evolving.
chest_rules.fractional_chance_note: Minute 3 Giant Mummy chest lists a 0.1% 5-item chance; code that int()s the chance reads it as 0.

reaper.spawn: 20:00 (stage end; wiki boss column lists The Reaper at 20:00), then one additional Reaper each minute afterwards
reaper.hp_note: multiplied by player level when spawned (HP x Level)
reaper.knockback_note: negative: hits drag it toward the player
reaper.behaviour: Rushes the player and deals 65,535 damage, ending the run. Surviving to the end rewards 500 gold (revive bonuses stack +100 each up to +400). Orologion/other freeze can freeze it per wiki text (wiki lists freeze resistance 1 but the text says freezing is possible - contradictory; Orologion freeze goes through freeze resistance).

rosary.effect: kills all enemies (on screen) that are not immune to instant kill; bosses/Reaper resistant

orologion.effect: freezes all enemies for 10 seconds; frozen enemies do not move or damage the player and can be pushed by walking into them; newly spawned enemies also freeze

vacuum.effect: pulls all Experience Gems on the ground to the player; ignores other pickups; takes time to arrive

nduja.effect: player breathes fire in facing direction for 10 s (damage 30, cooldown 0.5s, interval 0.04s per weapon table)
